title: NFL Prop Analytics Step 5 Verified Roster Truth Layer
scope: Populate the frozen Page 2 matchup shell with verified QB/RB/WR/TE roster identity using independent current-roster evidence. Require exact ESPN athlete IDs to match nflverse weekly roster espn_id values and require both sources to report roster-eligible status. No props, odds, projections, Passing Yards changes, or existing NFL market changes.

source_router.identity_key: ESPN athlete id / nflverse espn_id exact match
source_router.verified_rule: Exact ID + exact QB/RB/WR/TE position + roster-eligible status from both independent sources.
source_router.disagreement_rule: Any missing source, position disagreement, or ineligible status prevents VERIFIED publication.
source_router.fail_closed_rule: Page 2 roster truth is not LIVE unless both teams have at least one independently verified QB, RB, WR, and TE.

acceptance: Only exact player IDs independently present in ESPN current roster and nflverse weekly roster may render VERIFIED.
QB/RB/WR/TE position must agree across both roster sources.
Inactive/reserve/practice-squad/suspended source rows cannot render VERIFIED.
Both selected teams must have at least one independently verified QB, RB, WR, and TE or Step 5 fails closed.
Page 2 renders verified player names grouped by away/home team and QB/RB/WR/TE.
Every published player exposes source_count=2 and VERIFIED provenance.
Step 4 product module and ledger remain byte-identical.
390/768/1440 roster truth has no horizontal overflow.
Public production proof passes before Step 5 is declared GREEN + FROZEN.
